name: ❓ Question
about: How do I use X? — not a bug, not a feature request
title: "[QUESTION] "
labels: ["question"]

## Question

A clear, specific question. Example: "How do I add a new RSS feed to the
template?"

## What you have tried

What you already attempted (read docs, tried commands, grepped the code).
This helps avoid answers pointing at things you already checked.

## Your context

- **Are you**: a developer trying to fork the template / running it locally
  / running it on a VPS / just reading the code?
- **What is your goal**: news channel for X / internal monitoring / research
  / teaching example?

## Related docs

If you have specific doc sections in mind, link them:
- [README.md](README.md)
- [architecture overview](docs/architecture/00-overview.md)
- [self-host guide](docs/architecture/07-self-host.md)
- [operational playbook](docs/architecture/08-operational-playbook.md)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched [existing issues](https://github.com/DimbikeY/media-fabrique-template/issues) for duplicates
- [ ] I have read the relevant section of the docs (linked above)
- [ ] I am not asking for support on a customized fork — this is a template-level question
